description: This Java interface defines a builder pattern for constructing responses and events related to the 'DeleteFeatureDefinition' command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains nested factory interfaces for creating command responses and event instances, including specific error responses.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface extending a generic modify command response builder, serving as the main contract for building responses and events related to deleting feature definitions in live commands.

classes.name: ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating different types of command responses, including successful deletion and specific error scenarios.

classes.name: EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event instances triggered by delete feature definition commands, specifically the deletion event.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a feature definition was successfully deleted.

methods.name: featureDefinitionNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature definition could not be accessed.

methods.name: featureDefinitionNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature definition could not be modified.

methods.name: deleted (in EventFactory)
methods.description: Creates a 'FeatureDefinitionDeleted' event for the delete command.
